verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents several natural-language ways to operate it. Ask AI answers plain-language questions about the inbox. Its official MCP server lets users drive the inbox and calendar from Claude or ChatGPT with prompts to summarize, draft, send and schedule, with sends requiring approval. Users can also create agents via chat and personalize features with plain-language instructions. missing for 10: documented in-app natural-language commands for arbitrary actions (Cmd+K is a command palette, not documented as natural-language), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools.
Connect Claude or ChatGPT directly to your inbox to read, draft, and send emails with a single prompt — no copy-pasting required.
Just ask: _"where is the q2 offsite"_, _"when is my flight"_, _"where am I staying"_, and we'll immediately generate succinct answers.
Handle every follow-up with one prompt.
Use chat or our visual builder to create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect.
